decisions.statement: Judge-human agreement on money: Krippendorff's alpha = 0.821 [0.712, 0.901], n=64. Above the pre-registered threshold of 0.667; used for headline scoring.
Judge-human agreement on invoice_date: Krippendorff's alpha = 0.744 [0.653, 0.826], n=58. Above the pre-registered threshold of 0.667; used for headline scoring.

length_effect.statement: Length effect on money, by response-length quintile (shortest to longest): 0.80, 0.83, 0.86, 0.88, 0.85. No monotonic length bias detected.

note: Shape corrected post-review to match the REAL writer of this file, ground_truth.publish.artifacts.emit_all (a verbatim dump of the judge_decisions table: flat decisions[], alpha_low/alpha_high, lowercase status, no per-decision statement) -- not ground_truth.publish.leaderboard._agreement_to_dict, which this placeholder was originally (incorrectly) modeled on. order_effect, length_effect, confusion_matrix, and each decision's `statement` are still placeholder-only: emit_all scopes judge_agreement.json to what judge_decisions stores today, and none of those are stored anywhere queryable yet. web/app/judge/page.tsx treats all of them as optional and degrades gracefully when a real, narrower publish omits them.
